blocks.text: Ammonia acid se proton qubool kar ke ammonium banate hue Bronsted-Lowry base ka bartao karti hai: NH3(aq) + H+(aq) se NH4+(aq). Yeh pani mein hal ho kar ammonium hydroxide (NH4OH) banati hai, aur solution mein ammonia molecules aur ammonium ions ke darmiyan equilibrium qaim hota hai: NH3(aq) + H2O(l) NH4+(aq) + OH-(aq) ke saath equilibrium mein, Kb = 1.8 x 10^-5. Ammonia solution kam basicity constant aur equilibrium ki position bohat baen hone ki wajah se kamzor base hai.

blocks.title: Basicity constant Kb
blocks.text: Pani mein ammonia ke liye Kb = [NH4+][OH-] / [NH3] = 1.8 x 10^-5; chhoti qeemat ka matlab hai ke hal shuda ammonia ka sirf thora hissa ammonium aur hydroxide ions mein badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ammonia kamzor base kyun hai (exercise Q.2c)?
blocks.explanation: Pani mein ammonia protons sirf thori had tak qubool karti hai: equilibrium NH3 + H2O = NH4+ + OH- bohat baen hai, Kb sirf 1.8 x 10^-5, to paida hone wale hydroxide ions ki concentration NaOH jaise strong base ke muqable kam hai, jo poori tarah ionised hota hai.

items: Ammonia H+ qubool karti hai (Bronsted-Lowry base) aur NH4+ deti hai; pani mein NH3 + H2O = NH4+ + OH- Kb = 1.8 x 10^-5 ke saath, bohat baen: kamzor base.
